candidates.title: The Stars That Would Not Stay Sharp
story_beats: At the woodland trail, fox and rabbit discovered the observatory telescope showed trembling stars despite a clear sky before sunrise, leaving the first delivery of the day waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they cleaned the lens and refocused it but the stars kept wobbling; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized warm air from a roof exhaust vent crossed the telescope's line of sight; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.

With the first delivery of the day watching, they redirected the warm exhaust away from the viewing slit and checked the stars again, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
